Record Class ChromaticDefinitions.Snapshot

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
net.phoenix.chromatic_codes.api.ChromaticDefinitions.Snapshot
Record Components:
revision - increasing publication counter
caseSensitive - whether named lookups preserve case
inlineEnabled - whether bounded inline definitions may resolve
outlineColor - default outline RGB
bindings - bindings in declaration order
colors - lowercase character-to-RGB table
namedColors - named color lookup table
fonts - character-to-effect identities; these do not require separate font resources
namedFonts - name-to-effect identities
effects - identity-to-callback lookup table
outlines - enabled character outline triggers
namedOutlines - enabled named outline triggers
Enclosing class:
ChromaticDefinitions
public static record ChromaticDefinitions.Snapshot(long revision, boolean caseSensitive, boolean inlineEnabled, int outlineColor, List<ChromaticDefinitions.Binding> bindings, Map<Character, Integer> colors, Map<String,Integer> namedColors, Map<Character, net.minecraft.util.ResourceLocation> fonts, Map<String, net.minecraft.util.ResourceLocation> namedFonts, Map<net.minecraft.util.ResourceLocation, IChromaticEffect> effects, Set<Character> outlines, Set<String> namedOutlines) extends Record
Provides the lookup tables from one complete publication.

The owner constructs immutable collections. The public record constructor itself does not defensively copy arbitrary caller-supplied collections; use ChromaticDefinitions.snapshot() for an owner-created view.

      public final boolean equals(Object o)
      Indicates whether some other object is "equal to" this one. The objects are equal if the other object is of the same class and if all the record components are equal. Reference components are compared with Objects::equals(Object,Object); primitive components are compared with the compare method from their corresponding wrapper classes.
